params.body:
The README was rewritten in English on 12 September (#13), a week before the
Laravel 13 upgrade merged, so its Stack section describes the app as it was
before tonight. Every figure below was read out of the manifests on `main`
after the merge, not carried over.

| the README said | the repo says |
| --- | --- |
| PHP 8.4 | `"php": "^8.5"` |
| Laravel 12 | `"laravel/framework": "^13.0"` |
| Livewire 3 | `"livewire/livewire": "^4.0"` |
| built with Laravel Mix | `"vite": "^8.1.3"`, `npm run build` is `vite build` |
| spatie/laravel-permission | `"spatie/laravel-permission": "^8.0"` |
| Larastan at level 3 | `level: 5` in `phpstan.neon`, over `phpstan-baseline.neon` |

What stays: Tailwind CSS 4 (`"tailwindcss": "^4.1.17"`), Alpine 3, Vue 3, and
the clause about the Laravel 10 file layout, because `app/Console/Kernel.php`
does still exist.

Three other things it got wrong, all in the same spirit:

- `npm run watch` and `npm run prod` do not exist. `package.json` has `dev`,
  `build`, `lint` and `lint:fix`. The checks block now also names Pint and
  ESLint, which CI runs and the README did not mention.
- The command table missed `naviskore:smartschool-check`,
  `naviskore:report-snapshot` and `naviskore:report-snapshot-diff`, and still
  listed `wiskunde:herkoppel-doelen`, which is not in `app/Console/Commands`
  any more. The two snapshot commands get a sentence on why they exist, because
  a command whose purpose is "prove the reports did not change across an
  upgrade" is useless if nobody knows to reach for it.
- It described `elixir-fix.yml` and `evidence.yml` and said nothing about
  `ci.yml` or `mutation.yml`, which are the two that actually run on a push.

No code changed.
params.title: De README na de upgrade: PHP 8.5, Laravel 13, Vite 8
